The End Of The Beginning.
Analysis by Richard Cowan

As Churchill said when it became clear that the Nazis could not win World War II, "This is not the beginning of the end, but it is the end of the beginning." That is where we are in our battle against their successors.

Certainly, we also face a few terrible years ahead in which many lives will yet be ruined and much suffering will still be inflicted on the most vulnerable members of our society.

However, the fact is that the last few days have seen two major capitulations by the prohibitionist establishment. As I said Monday, we have won the hemp war.
See
Hawaii Gets DEA Permission To Grow Hemp Test Plot In Maximum Security,
Which Where They Want To Keep Hemp Users.
Alterna Issues Triumphant Press Release With Minimal Prohibitionist Propaganda

Today there are white flags showing up on the medical marijuana issue. Gore is in favor of "flexibility" on medical marijuana. Finally, the politicians have noticed the polls.
See
Gore’s Backs "Flexibility" On Medical Marijuana.
In Fact, His Position Is So Flexible That He Is On 3 Sides Of The Issue.
But The Washington Post Cites NORML; Now That Is A Miracle!

As the Post article also notes, Bush has endorsed a "states-rights" approach to medical marijuana, which now makes his position preferable to any of Gore’s three positions.
See
Bushlet Supports States’ Rights On Medical Marijuana;
At Odds With Party Leaders, The Anointed One Continues To Move To The Center.

The AMR strategy has been to get medical marijuana initiatives passed in enough states to force the Feds to do something. It seems to be working.
See

Whatever position Gore settles on for the near term, the medical marijuana issue now firmly on the public agenda. That is really the most important point here. The Washington Post ran its story on the front page, and actually cited NORML. Another miraculous accomplishment for medical marijuana!

The hucksters at Gary Bauer’s shop even felt it was opportune to put out a press release denouncing Gore.

See
Bauer’s Hucksters Pop Out Press Release In Response to Gore.

Bauer stands at 2% in the Republican polls. With enemies like this we don’t need as many friends.

Bush was not hurt at all by his support of states’ rights. However the problem that the Republicans have is that the reefer madness constituency -- the most ardent supporters of marijuana prohibition – also have control of the Republican the Death-Wish wing of the party, the prosecutorial right, as embodied by Barr, Hatch, Hastert and Lott, et al.

See
The Congressional Record On The House Medical Marijuana Debate
Requires Powerful Anti-Emetics

We can no more take victory for granted than Churchill could, but next year’s election provides an important opportunity to advance the issue. The strength of the medical marijuana movement in California is not lost on politicians in either party.

It is very unlikely that the White House can be won in 2000 without carrying California, where Prop 215 won by a much greater margin than Clinton.

Medical marijuana activists continue to work to consolidate their victories and implement the new state laws. This work is creating facts on the ground – rights and expectations that politicians will not want to oppose.
